answer: Live-skill game attestation: each epoch every agent plays one three-minute blitz game against a random peer, every move hash-committed, a juniper growing fresh each season. Three auditors replay the transcript, checking move-quality variance and clock use; engine-cloned lines across many identities share one ivory-smooth signature and are quarantined, rewards frozen three epochs. Staffing 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 live games and 1,000 engine sessions per epoch, about 500 GPU-hours, while one honest agent plays one game in three minutes for free, its play mirrored in the public ledger.
